name: Clojure
description: A dynamic, functional Lisp for the JVM.
summary: Clojure states that its code is written and reviewed by humans, and code generated by a large language model or similar technology is not acceptable for the project. A narrow exception may be made for human-written generators whose source code is contributed along with the patch.

evidence.quote: Clojure’s code is written and reviewed by humans.
is not compliant with the covenants and representations of Clojure’s Contributor’s Agreement, and is thus not acceptable as code for Clojure.
An exception may be made for human written generators whose source code is contributed along with the patch.
